# SMH Marine

> SMH Marine is a China-headquartered marine engineering, ship repair and owner-side technical consultancy company. The public website is available in English and Turkish and is designed to work without Google-hosted runtime services.

## Current approved company facts

- SMH Marine protects shipowners' technical and commercial interests in shipyard projects through scope, price, variation, progress and invoice control.
- China is the company's headquarters country and strongest shipyard base.
- The China-based delivery network includes more than 20 experienced local specialists, more than 15 years of Chinese shipyard experience and more than 200 coordinated repair and newbuilding projects.
- Evrim Biçer is Co-Founder responsible for Türkiye and Europe operations.
- Adem Çorbacı is Co-Founder responsible for China and Asia operations.
- The Shanghai contact office is at Room 1305, No. 1500 Century Avenue, Shanghai, China.

## Specialist services

- [Ship Repair and Dry-Docking](https://ibrahimtugsan-dot.github.io/smh-marine-test-site/ship-repair.html): repair specification, shipyard comparison, price negotiation, docking, steel renewal, supervision, variation control and close-out.
- [Main Engine and Crankshaft Works](https://ibrahimtugsan-dot.github.io/smh-marine-test-site/engine-crankshaft.html): two-stroke and four-stroke engine repairs, crankshaft inspection and repair coordination, alignment, testing and technical records.
- [Owner Representation](https://ibrahimtugsan-dot.github.io/smh-marine-test-site/owner-representation.html): independent owner-side technical and commercial control from tender review to final invoice.
- [Newbuilding Supervision](https://ibrahimtugsan-dot.github.io/smh-marine-test-site/newbuilding.html): contract, pricing, site-team, quality, trials and delivery support.
- [Pre-Purchase Inspection](https://ibrahimtugsan-dot.github.io/smh-marine-test-site/pre-purchase.html): document review, onboard inspection, condition assessment, risk identification and repair-budget input.
- [Special Survey Preparation](https://ibrahimtugsan-dot.github.io/smh-marine-test-site/special-survey.html): pre-docking inspection, class and statutory survey preparation, repair specification, tender review and docking planning.
- [Retrofit Operations and Energy Efficiency](https://ibrahimtugsan-dot.github.io/smh-marine-test-site/retrofit-energy-efficiency.html): feasibility, shaft generators, LED conversion, propeller and stern-flow improvements, installation control and performance verification.
- [Emergency repair coordination in China](https://ibrahimtugsan-dot.github.io/smh-marine-test-site/#china): electrical faults, HVAC and refrigeration, cranes, two-stroke and four-stroke engines, windlasses, mooring winches, deck machinery, afloat and voyage repairs.

## Service network

SMH Marine coordinates services through 24 approved network locations: Istanbul, Yalova, Canakkale, Lisbon, Dakar, Antwerp, Rotterdam, Amsterdam, Gdynia, Klaipėda, Oman, Dubai, Bahrain, Qatar, Veracruz, Rio de Janeiro, Shanghai, Dalian, Nantong, Zhoushan, Tianjin, Singapore, Batam and Bangkok.

These locations represent service coordination, technical contacts and partner/shipyard-network coverage. They are not SMH Marine offices unless a page explicitly identifies an office.

## Türkçe kısa özet

SMH Marine, merkezi Çin'de bulunan; gemi onarımı, deniz mühendisliği, yeni inşa, sörvey hazırlığı, enerji verimliliği ve armatör adına teknik-ticari kontrol hizmetleri sunan bir denizcilik şirketidir. Haritadaki 24 nokta, şirket ofislerini değil hizmet ve koordinasyon ağını gösterir. İletişim: +90 530 505 21 40, evrim@smh-marine.com.

## Content status

All 47 supplied project photographs are represented: one hero image and 46 gallery images grouped by visible technical work scope. Vessel names, registry details, IMO numbers and identifying markings have been removed where required. Named vessel, shipyard, location, commercial result, saving, class approval or partnership claims are not published and must not be inferred.
